title: Format page
description: Lathe's record format, in the wiki card over the stage (`?page=format`): how records are kept, then an index of the kinds by stage, the relations and the checks by severity.

title: Kind page
description: What the reference says about one kind, its columns included, in the wiki card over the stage (`?page=format/kinds/<kind>`).

title: Check page
description: One check's severity, explanation, query and the problems it reports now, in the wiki card over the stage (`?page=format/checks/<check>`).

title: Checks panel
description: Tools › Checks, a panel over the stage (`?panel=checks` on any focus): every problem of the space's product, errors first, grouped by check, then the workspace's under Workspace and the recorded exceptions. Selecting a problem focuses its record on the stage.

title: Product page
description: The product's one page, at its ID: its description, its domains as cards with coverage bars (designed, built and proved) and tests by state, its summary of what Lathe counts across it, its open questions and its problems, with its facts, children and links both ways in the wiki card.

title: Workbench
description: The app's frame around every page: the stage behind it, the floating panels over it (the navigation, the tab panel with the page bar and the header strip, and the wiki card), tooltips, the keys and the announcer, and on a phone the top bar, the drawers and the sheets.

title: Appearance
description: A popover over the stage, anchored to its button at the foot of the nav (`?panel=appearance`): the mode choice and every theme, previewed live on the stage, with import and export; and the theme editor, a larger panel over the stage (`?panel=theme&theme=<id>`), for a theme of one's own.

title: Theme picker
description: The Color theme and Light, dark or system quick picks, which preview as they are arrowed.

title: Quick open
description: Quick find and the command palette as one overlay in the upper middle of the window: the current space's records by ID or title, with the highlighted one previewed on the stage, or, after a ">", every command that applies, with its keys.

title: Shortcuts sheet
description: Every shortcut grouped as Navigate, View, Graph and Lists, with a search and the override note.

title: Native menus
description: The desktop app's menu bar: the app menu, File, Edit, View, Window and Help.

title: Desktop title bar
description: The app's own 38 px bar in the desktop window: back and forward, the command center and the layout toggles.

title: Launch view
description: The shell color, the logo and "Opening <product>…" until the page has its specs.

title: Error page
description: The engine's message, with Retry, Open Another Folder and Reveal in Finder.

title: About window
description: The app's, the engine's and Electron's versions, with links to the repo and the record format.

title: Dock icon
description: Lathe's icon in the Dock, with its badge and its menu.

title: Nav
description: The left menu: with two or more products, a rail with one icon per product (each product a space), and a panel listing the current space's domains with their capabilities, headed by its name and icon. It holds the Go to button that opens quick find (LA-V64) and the stage folders.

title: Domain page
description: The domain's one page, at its ID: its description, its records grouped by stage, a search box, and the domain's coverage (designed, built and proved), gaps and problems, with its facts, children and links both ways in the wiki card.

title: Record page
description: One record: its text fields rendered as Markdown, its part rows and other fields, parent and children, links out and in grouped by relation, and its problems.

title: Graph stage
description: The whole model as one map, shown on the Graph stage of an address and focused on that record (or a group of the graph's tree, at its address): laid out left to right in columns by depth in the parent/child tree, like a folder tree, every parent as tall as its children and every sibling in one column, children grouped by kind, each kind drawn in its own shape (a domain a hexagon). It draws the tree alone: a record's links to other branches are the Trace stage's and the wiki card's. The camera frames the focus and the levels the depth asks for in the open space the floating panels leave; every stage's toolbar floating at the top of that space holds the steps, Out, In and Frame, then the layout and depth switches and the kind filters, then the key, with a minimap and the camera's zoom and fit buttons at its corners (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21).

title: ERD stage
description: One map of the whole product's entity-relationship diagram, laid out once per product and data change: each domain a region, its aggregates boundaries around their entities, and the relationships between them, across regions where they cross domains. Every focus navigates the map: what lies outside the focus's scope fades, the focus's box is picked out, and the camera glides to frame it in the open space the floating panels leave, under every stage's toolbar and camera, its key in the toolbar's Key popover (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21). It draws entities and their relationships only.

title: Focus page
description: One full-window stage, the Graph, the ERD or the Trace, switched in the page bar and named in the address, with everything else floating over it as frosted panels: the nav, the tab panel (the page bar with its tabs, then the header strip naming the focus) and the wiki card with the focus's wiki page. The stage frames the focus in the open space the panels leave, and every stage has the same controls in the same places: a toolbar centered at the top of the open space and the camera's buttons at the frame's bottom left (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21).

title: Products picker
description: The space chooser at `/`: a card centered over the dimmed stage of the last product the Reader was in, or over an empty map on a first launch, with every product, its look and its number of domains.

title: Trace stage
description: What a product owes and how far it has come, drawn on the canvas with the graph's renderer, camera and pointer as one map of the whole product, laid out once per product and data change: a "why" tree on the left from its business outcomes (the capabilities that serve them, their use cases, an obligation's own parent) and one lane per obligation on the right in the tree's order, its chain left to right (what designs it, builds it, proves it and the files they name, an arrow for each actual link), every gap a dashed empty box in its column and the Untraced records in a lane of their own at the bottom. Focusing anything moves the camera to frame it and fades the rest; Gaps only fades the complete lanes; nothing ever re-lays out (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R19). Far out the lanes are bars, so the whole product reads as an overview. Its toolbar and camera are every stage's (LA-PAT-APP-UX-R21), with Gaps only as its own control and its key in the Key popover. The table of the chains under the focus is its accessible layer, visually hidden under the canvas, and the whole stage on a phone.

title: Chat panel
description: The desktop app's conversation with the Owner's own Claude Code, floating at the right over the stage the full height of the window: its head names the session and opens the session picker and the help; the log holds the messages, Claude's answers as rich text with record links, tool rows, permission prompts and each turn's changed records; the composer at its foot sends, and becomes Stop while Claude works.
